object.caption: Purchase history
object.userHelp: CRM → Reports → Purchase history. Draft and cancelled realizations are excluded. Amount is quantity × unit price of the line. Loyalty points are the LoyaltyPoints register, not this report.
object.devComment: Positions and amounts from issued sales realizations by customer, item and document. Points stay on LoyaltyPoints — a second grain would multiply them across items.
object.name: CustomerPurchaseHistoryReport
